operating_rules: CURRENT contains at most one actively implemented product train and may be empty between merged trains.
NEXT is ordered and contains concrete player-facing trains, not cleanup placeholders.
Canonical Zork solutions remain valid even when new physically valid workarounds are added.
A reusable object or learned workaround remains useful wherever the same physical logic reasonably applies.
Cleverness should reduce repeated friction rather than create a new fetch-grind tax.
Soft sequence breaks are allowed only when physically earned, state-safe, and non-bricking.
No universal crafting grid, arbitrary object-pair matrix, generic physics simulator, recursive audit machinery, TODO-only slice, or no-op scaffolding.
DONE requires merged or otherwise immutable proof.

current.title: Grue Ecology & Colony Reveal
current.outcome: Turn one optional mine dead end into authored grue ecology: ordinary light reveals plural indirect evidence, while the permanent flaming ivory torch forces a signature multi-fissure retreat and proves a colony without making grues visible combat mobs.
current.showcase: Targetable mine fissures own the zero-global reveal state; lamp light exposes multiple scrapes; the ivory torch drives many separate retreats through different cracks; post-reveal GRUE and fissure examination/listening report ecology evidence while canonical darkness lethality remains unchanged.
acceptance: DEAD-END-5 is the only authored colony site in this train
the fissures are targetable and own their reveal state through an explicit VALUE property
ordinary lamp light produces plural indirect evidence without revealing the colony
the permanent flaming ivory torch triggers the signature colony reveal
post-reveal GRUE EXAMINE FIND and LISTEN report plural ecology without exposing a visible grue body
canonical gverbs.zil darkness and grue lethal/noise machinery is byte-for-byte unchanged from Release 1255
no new VM global is consumed
no grue hit points, combat stats, monster-attractor engine, colony counter, or generic hive system is added
production artifact is locked and reproducible
boundaries: grues remain mysterious and dangerous
not every dark room becomes a hive
canonical darkness death remains authority
no ordinary visible grue combat mobs

next.title: Fire, Smoke & Structural Consequences
next.outcome: Extend material physicality into a deliberately small set of authored fire, smoke, collapse, and machinery consequences with fair warnings, escape routes, mitigation, persistent damage, and recovery.
boundaries: reuse existing flame light and material state
no generalized chemistry or gas simulator
no gore escalation
canonical puzzle state remains authoritative

next.title: Mara Reciprocal Rescue & Shared Danger
next.outcome: Advance Mara through shared physical danger, reciprocal rescue, injuries/recovery, promises, temporary custody, separation/reunion, and remembered choices rather than an approval economy.
boundaries: no dating-sim meter
no omniscient companion AI
no generic party framework

future.title: Treasure Guardian Dragon & Hoard
future.outcome: Create an original Zork-native dragon guarding a real treasure hoard, with territorial warning signs, dangerous fire breath, persistent environmental consequences, and multiple credible Zork-style approaches to survival, theft, containment, escape, trickery, or confrontation.
boundaries: original Zork-native dragon, prose, map layout, objects, puzzle expression, and solution structure
fire breath composes with authored fire, smoke, material, shelter, and escape systems
not a generic hit-point boss fight
do not copy Shadowgate source code, text, art, maps, exact puzzles, or expressive sequencing

future.title: Cross-IF / RPG Mechanics Adaptation — Shadowgate First
future.outcome: Study high-value mechanics and interaction patterns from other interactive-fiction games and RPGs, beginning with Shadowgate, then rebuild selected concepts from scratch as original Zork-native systems that compose with canonical state and the physicality mesh.
boundaries: borrow concepts and design lessons, not source code, text, art, maps, exact puzzles, or expressive sequencing
adapt only mechanics that create meaningful Zork player choices rather than feature accumulation
rebuild selected ideas from scratch using Zork-native objects, state, prose, geography, parser verbs, and consequence systems
keep the separate S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Glulx product lane distinct

future.title: Forest That Answers Back / Described World = Interactive World
future.outcome: Turn selected concrete nouns already present in authored forest descriptions into targetable, stateful world objects whose interactions compose with existing physicality instead of remaining decorative prose.
boundaries: no procedural object generator
no universal interaction matrix
promote authored nouns selectively where interaction creates real play

future.title: Time, Weather & Disaster Arc
future.outcome: Layer authored time and weather conditions plus selected disasters onto real geography and material state to create preparation, shelter, traversal, rescue, and aftermath play.
boundaries: no generic climate simulator
reuse existing geography and object state
conditions must create visible player choices and consequences

future.title: Causal Death & Warning Depth
future.outcome: Broaden fair cause-warning-consequence chains, near-death records, delayed consequences, and exact-object provenance without turning death into a generic simulation framework.

future.title: Museum & Ecology Second Expansion
future.outcome: Continue physical specimen, provenance, collection, and ecology stories only where they create new field play rather than checklist accumulation.

future.title: Narrative Perspective Experiments
future.outcome: Build isolated first-person, third-person, and interactive-storybook editions against real canonical state without changing normal Zork.

future.title: DRAW + Multi-Agent Experiments
future.outcome: Explore DRAW and multi-agent interactive-fiction experiments only after the playable product supports them, keeping experiments isolated from the canonical release train until deliberately promoted.

parked.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Glulx Game
parked.outcome: Remain a separate interactive-fiction product lane, never mixed into a Zork gameplay PR.

parked.title: Protected Corpus Acquisition
parked.outcome: Expand source evidence only through lawfully held local copies or verified rights.
